name: geo-analyzer-extension
description: Chrome Extension for GEO analysis of web pages with score tracking, trend analysis and history

scripts.dev: npm run build:popup && npm run build:content -- --watch
scripts.build: npm run build:popup && npm run build:content && npm run build:background && npm run build:report && node scripts/post-build.js
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../geo-analyzer-extension.zip .
